description: This PHP source file defines a class 'LDAPConfigAPI' which is part of an API for managing LDAP configuration in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving and updating LDAP settings, validation rules, and API documentation annotations for REST endpoints.

classes.name: LDAPConfigAPI
classes.description: This class provides REST API endpoints for managing LDAP configuration in the OrangeHRM system, including methods to retrieve current LDAP settings and update configurations with validation and annotation for API documentation.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles updating LDAP configuration settings based on JSON request input, performing validation, and saving new settings.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves current LDAP configuration settings, or returns default if none are configured.
